notes: There is no public transport in Bali: use a scooter (international licence and helmet), Grab/Gojek or a car with a driver by the day (~700,000 IDR). Allow 1-2 hours of traffic between Ubud, Canggu and Uluwatu.
November to March is the rainy season: expect afternoon downpours, possible Penida boat cancellations and a cloudy Batur. Sightsee in the morning and save spas and cafes for later.
Temples require a sarong and sash (provided at the entrance). Women cannot enter during menstruation, and ceremony days call for respect.
Babi guling costs 40-60,000 IDR at a warung and nasi campur 30-50,000. Beach club minimum spend is 300-500,000.
Monkeys (Uluwatu, Monkey Forest) snatch glasses and phones. Don't show them food.
Take the Nusa Penida tour on the morning boat from Sanur. The Kelingking descent is hard, so the view from the top is enough.

stops.name: Tegallalang Rice Terrace
stops.tips: Terraced rice fields, quiet and cool at 07:30. The swing is an optional 150,000 IDR.

stops.name: Tirta Empul
stops.tips: Holy spring purification temple. A sarong is provided, and the pool has 13 spouts.

stops.name: Ubud Palace
stops.tips: Royal palace courtyard with an evening legong dance (100,000 IDR).

stops.name: Warung Babi Guling Ibu Oka
stops.tips: Bourdain's roast pork, opposite the palace. It sells out by lunchtime.

stops.name: Ubud Monkey Forest
stops.tips: Sacred monkey forest and temples. Watch your glasses and bag.

backups.name: Warung Babi Guling Gung Cung
backups.tips: Local babi guling (roast suckling pig) near the palace.

backups.name: Campuhan Ridge Walk
backups.tips: A 2 km ridge walk, also good for sunset.

stops.name: Mount Batur Sunrise Trek
stops.tips: Can be slippery in the rainy season, and cloud is likely. A jeep tour is the alternative.

stops.name: Toya Devasya Hot Springs
stops.tips: Hot springs on the shore of Lake Batur, ideal after the trek.

stops.name: Ubud Art Market
stops.tips: Souvenir market. Start bargaining at half the asking price.

stops.name: Warung Biah Biah Ubud
stops.tips: Balinese tapas (small plates), local and good value.

stops.name: Saraswati Temple
stops.tips: Temple with a lotus pond, next to Starbucks.

backups.name: Warung Pulau Kelapa Ubud
backups.tips: Indonesian cuisine in a garden setting.

backups.name: Tegenungan Waterfall
backups.tips: Waterfall near Ubud, an alternative to the hot springs.

stops.name: Jatiluwih Rice Terraces
stops.tips: UNESCO-listed terraces, wider and calmer than Tegallalang, with walking routes.

stops.name: Ulun Danu Beratan Temple
stops.tips: The 'floating' temple on the lake, set against misty mountains.

stops.name: Jatiluwih Warung Dhea
stops.tips: Nasi campur (mixed rice plate) with terrace views.

stops.name: Tanah Lot
stops.tips: Rock temple in the sea. Sunset is the most famous time, and it gets crowded.

stops.name: Canggu Batu Bolong Beach
stops.tips: Canggu's beach bars: a beer after sunset and the lights of the surfers.

backups.name: Handara Gate
backups.tips: The Instagram gate, next to the lake temple.

stops.name: Echo Beach Canggu
stops.tips: In the rainy season, morning is your window. Rubbish can wash in with the waves.

stops.name: Crate Cafe Canggu
stops.tips: Canggu's brunch culture, with smoothie bowls.

stops.name: Seminyak Village
stops.tips: Boutiques and a mall on Oberoi Street.

stops.name: Babi Guling Pak Malen Seminyak
stops.tips: Seminyak's babi guling (roast suckling pig), with crackling skin.

stops.name: Seminyak Beach Sunset
stops.tips: Ku De Ta or Potato Head beach club (minimum spend), or a beanbag on the sand for sunset.

backups.name: Potato Head Beach Club
backups.tips: Beach club with a pool and DJ.

backups.name: Petitenget Temple
backups.tips: Seminyak's temple, best on ceremony days.

stops.name: Kelingking Beach
stops.tips: Speedboat from Sanur takes 45 minutes, plus a vehicle tour (~900,000 IDR). T-rex rock and views from above (the descent takes 1 hour and is hard).

stops.name: Angel's Billabong
stops.tips: Natural pool. Swimming is forbidden at high tide.

stops.name: Broken Beach
stops.tips: Cove with a natural rock arch.

stops.name: Nusa Penida Warung Crystal Bay
stops.tips: Warung at Crystal Bay, serving nasi goreng (fried rice).

stops.name: Crystal Bay Snorkelling
stops.tips: See manta rays at Manta Point (boat ~200,000 IDR) or snorkel at Crystal Bay. Boat back at 16:00.

backups.name: Diamond Beach
backups.tips: White sand in east Penida, instead of snorkelling.

stops.name: Padang Padang Beach
stops.tips: Small cove reached through the rocks. Quiet in the morning, with monkeys.

stops.name: Bingin Beach Warung
stops.tips: Grilled fish at the cliffside warungs, reached by steps.

stops.name: Single Fin Uluwatu
stops.tips: Cliff bar for watching the surf and for lunch.

stops.name: Uluwatu Temple
stops.tips: Sea temple on a cliff. Monkeys snatch glasses, and a sarong is included.

stops.name: Kecak Fire Dance Uluwatu
stops.tips: Kecak performed by 100 people at sunset. Buy your ticket at 17:00 and sit at the front.

backups.name: Suluban Beach
backups.tips: Surf beach reached through a cave, instead of Padang Padang.

backups.name: Jimbaran Bay Seafood Grill
backups.tips: Seafood grilled on the sand, on the way back from Uluwatu.

stops.name: Sanur Beach Promenade
stops.tips: A 5 km seafront path. Sunrise is on Bali's east coast, with calm water.

stops.name: Sindhu Market Sanur
stops.tips: Morning market for bubur (rice porridge) and coffee.

stops.name: Sanur Village Spa
stops.tips: Balinese massage to say goodbye.

stops.name: Warung Mak Beng Sanur
stops.tips: Fried fish and soup since 1941, with a single set menu.

stops.name: Ngurah Rai Airport Transfer
stops.tips: The airport is 30 minutes away. Time to say goodbye.

backups.name: Le Mayeur Museum Sanur
backups.tips: The Belgian painter's house, instead of the spa.
